topic_name: Drawing with a Ruler and a Compass
title: Kolam circle, wobbly and smooth
description: A wobbly grey freehand circle with a gap in it beside a smooth teal circle with 4 amber dots around it.

topic_name: Circles with a Compass
title: Hand circle against round circle
description: A teal round circle with a reddish purple wobbly hand-drawn outline laid over it, drifting outside in two places and inside in two places.

topic_name: Circles with a Compass
title: Dots 4 cm from P
description: A spot P with a ruler from its 0 cm mark to a 4 cm dot and 12 teal dots evenly spaced round P on a faint grey circle.

topic_name: Circles with a Compass
title: Compass opened to 4 cm
description: A compass opened to 4 cm with its tip on P, a teal circle of radius 4 cm around P and a purple line from P to the circle labelled 4 cm.

topic_name: Waves from Half Circles

description: A line AB of 8 cm with its middle X, a teal half circle above on AX and an amber half circle below on XB, each with a 2 cm radius.

topic_name: Arcs for A Person and Eyes
title: Tip above for a dipping arc
description: A teal rectangle body whose top edge dips in the middle, with an amber compass tip dot above it joined by two grey lines to the top corners.

topic_name: Arcs for A Person and Eyes
title: Two arcs make an eye
description: An almond eye with a teal upper arc and an amber lower arc, and two tip dots, one below and one above, equally far from the middle.

topic_name: What Makes a Square or a Rectangle
title: Rectangle and square
description: A teal 6 by 3 rectangle with tick marks on opposite sides and four right angle signs, beside an amber square of side 3 with four equal tick marks and four right angle signs.

topic_name: What Makes a Square or a Rectangle
title: Naming a rectangle in order
description: A teal rectangle with corners A, B, C, D in order round the edge and a purple arrow going round the edge from A back to A.

topic_name: Rotated Squares and Rectangles

description: A flat teal square and the same square turned 45 degrees on one corner, both with equal tick marks and right angle signs, joined by a curved arrow.

topic_name: Rotated Squares and Rectangles

description: A tilted square with corners on dots; side PQ goes 3 across and 2 down, side QR goes 2 across and 3 down, with a right angle at Q.

topic_name: Constructing a Square

description: Square PQRS with side PQ marked 6 cm, four right-angle marks and two grey arcs showing how S and R were found.

topic_name: Constructing a Square
title: Neighbouring sides match
description: Square PQRS with PQ and PS both marked 6 cm and carrying the same tick mark.

topic_name: Constructing a Rectangle
title: Perpendiculars stay parallel
description: Rectangle ABCD with two vertical sides and two equal grey arrows at the bottom and the top labelled same distance.

topic_name: How Far Apart Can Two Points Be?
title: Rectangle 7 by 4
description: Rectangle ABCD, 7 cm wide and 4 cm tall, with right-angle marks at every corner.

topic_name: How Far Apart Can Two Points Be?

description: Three rectangles with a thread in each: two tilted, one flat, read as 7 cm 4 mm, 7 cm 0 mm and 7 cm 3 mm.

topic_name: How Far Apart Can Two Points Be?
title: Equal heights, same length
description: Rectangle ABCD with three flat parallel threads at different heights, all as long as the 7 cm base AB.

topic_name: Breaking Rectangles into Squares
title: Rectangle from two squares
description: Rectangle 8 cm by 4 cm split in the middle into two equal squares of side 4 cm.

topic_name: Breaking Rectangles into Squares
title: Rectangle from three squares
description: Rectangle 9 cm by 3 cm divided into three equal squares of side 3 cm.

topic_name: Breaking Rectangles into Squares
title: Not identical squares
description: Rectangle 7 cm by 2 cm with two squares cut from the left and a 3 cm by 2 cm leftover that is not a square.

topic_name: Squares with Holes, Shadings and Curves
title: Centre of the square
description: Square of side 6 cm with two diagonals meeting at O and a circle of radius 2 cm centred at O inside it.

topic_name: Diagonals of a Rectangle

description: A 6 cm by 4 cm rectangle PQRS with diagonal PR in teal and diagonal QS in amber, both the same length.

topic_name: Diagonals of a Rectangle

description: A 6 cm by 4 cm rectangle with diagonal PR; at P the small angle of about 34 degrees in teal and the larger angle of about 56 degrees in amber.

topic_name: When a Diagonal Splits a Corner Equally
title: Square cuts corner equally
description: Left a 6 cm by 4 cm rectangle with its diagonal giving about 34 and 56 degrees; right a 5 cm square with its diagonal giving 45 and 45 degrees.

topic_name: When a Diagonal Splits a Corner Equally
title: Square with both diagonals
description: A 5 cm square with both diagonals in teal, each about 7.1 cm, and one 45 degree angle shaded in amber at a corner.

topic_name: Constructing a Rectangle from a Diagonal Angle

topic_name: Constructing a Rectangle from a Side and a Diagonal

topic_name: Constructing a Rectangle from a Side and a Diagonal
title: Corner B on a line
description: Base DC of 5 cm, a vertical line l at C, point B on l, and the 7 cm diagonal DB in teal.

topic_name: Constructing a Rectangle from a Side and a Diagonal
title: Checking a rectangle
description: Rectangle ABCD with opposite sides of 5 cm in teal and about 4.9 cm in amber marked equal, and a right angle mark at each corner.

topic_name: Points the Same Distance from Two Points

topic_name: Points the Same Distance from Two Points
title: House from crossing arcs
description: A house outline with a 5 cm square base, a roof point A made by two crossing 5 cm arcs, and a curve centred at A from B to C.
